name: Dracotaur
body:
Dracotaurs are a species of imperialistic, centaur-like dragons known for their haughty superiority complex and cruel indifference to lesser beings.

Physical

A dracotaur’s lower body resembles a wingless dragon or other large reptile. They have a broad stance and a wide, spiked tail. Their scales are shiny and range from emerald green to ebony to bright scarlet, with a few having metallic overtones. A dracotaur’s upper body is more humanoid in shape. The scales are usually smoother and sleeker, and may be a different color. The dracotaur’s head is large and impressive with distinctly draconic features and large, strong jaws. Some also have horns, crests, or distinctive ridges. Their eyes are large and unblinking, and seem to glow with malevolence.

Social

Dracotaurs society is regimented and militaristic in the extreme. They see all nondragons as little more than animals, and treat them as such—readily using them as either food or slaves, as they see fit. Dracotaurs are aggressive and argumentative, but will fall in line for a strong leader. They prize strength and loyalty above all else. Despite all of their bluster, they are not particularly brave, preferring to hire mercenaries or train slave thralls to do their fighting for them. Part of the reason behind this is the dracotaurs’ low population—they are few in number, and must constantly make calculated tactical maneuvers in order to bolster their standing. Dracotaurs love both combat and magic, and many multiclass or take levels in classes that specialize in both areas, such as magus, ranger, or (anti)paladin.

Alignment And Religion

Most dracotaurs faithfully worship the draconic pantheon of deities, gravitating toward the Lawful Evil ones. Some ambitious dracotaurs have been known to supplement this faith with diabolism, contracting with devils in order to gain a perceived advantage over their foes.

Core Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are robust and strong, but cold and affectless. Your ability score modifiers are +2 Str, +2 Con, –2 Cha [specialized]. (1)
Note: After your modifiers for being size Large are incorporated, your net ability score adjustments are: +4 Str, +2 Con, –2 Dex, –2 Cha.
Size As a Large creature, you have a –1 size penalty on attack rolls, a –1 size penalty to your Armor Class, a +1 size bonus to your CMB, and a –4 size penalty on Stealth checks. As a Large creature, you occupy a space of 10 feet by 10 feet. Your reach is 5 feet. You take a further –2 penalty to Dex, and gain a further +2 bonus to Str. (7)
Type You are a Dragon. (10)
Speed Your base speed is 40 feet. (0)
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Draconic. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Aquan, Auran, Elven, Ignan, Giant, Orc, or Terran. (0)
Other Traits
Bite You can make a bite attack with your powerful jaws. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d6 damage. (2)
Breath Weapon Once per hour, you can breathe fire in a 30-foot cone as a standard action. When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of effect must make a Reflex saving throw (DC 10 +1/2 your character level + your Constitution modifier). A creature takes 2d6 damage on a failed save, or half damage on a successful one. The damage increases by 1d6 at 6th level and every 5 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 5d6 damage at 16th level. (4)
Darkvision You have darkvision 60 feet. (—)
Draconic Immunities You are immune to magical sleep effects and paralysis effects. (—)
Low-light Vision You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions. (—)
Natural Armor You have tough, scaly skin that provides a +1 natural armor bonus to AC. (2)
Quadruped Your four legs provide you with a +4 species bonus to CMD against trip attempts and a +10 foot bonus to your land speed (included in your speed, above). You use the quadruped rules to determine your carrying capacity. You use weapons as if you were size Medium instead of Large. (2)
Tail Slap You have a wide tail that you can use to attack your foes. This is a secondary natural attack that deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage plus 1/2 your Strength modifier. (1)
Total: 29 Rp (monstrous)
Alternate Traits
Alternate Breath Weapon Instead of fire, you can choose acid, cold, or electricity damage for your breath weapon. Additionally, you can choose to have your breath weapon shaped as a 60-foot line instead of a 30-foot cone, regardless of which energy type you choose. Once you have made this decision, it cannot be changed. This trait alters breath weapon.
Brilliance Your scales aren’t as thick as most dracotaurs, but they give you a radiant, commanding presence. Diplomacy and Intimidate are always class skills for you. If either of these skills is already a class skill for you, you instead gain a +1 species bonus on checks with that skill. This trait replaces natural armor.
Energy Resistance You gain fire resistance 10. If you have the alternate breath weapon alternate species trait, you instead gain resistance 10 matching the energy type of your breath weapon. This trait replaces natural armor.
Fire in the Blood You gain fast healing 2 for one round anytime you take fire damage (whether or not this fire damage overcomes your fire resistance, if any). You can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This trait replaces breath weapon.
Gore You have horns or crests on your head that you can use to make a gore attack. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. This trait replaces tail slap.
Sleek You are not as physically powerful as most dracotaurs, but you are more agile and have a commanding presence. Your ability score modifiers are +2 Str, +2 Cha (this includes your adjustments for being size Large). This trait alters ability score modifiers and replaces tail slap.
Spell Resistance You are especially resistant to magic. You gain spell resistance equal to 11 + your character level. This trait replaces breath weapon.
Favored Class Bonuses
Alchemist Add +1/2 to your bomb damage.
Antipaladin Add a +1 bonus on concentration checks when casting antipaladin spells.
Barbarian Add +2 to your Constitution score for the purpose of determining when you die from negative hit points.
Bard Reduce the penalty for not being proficient with one weapon by 1. When the nonproficiency penalty for a weapon becomes 0 because of this ability, you are treated as having the appropriate Martial or Exotic Weapon Proficiency feat for that weapon.
Bloodrager Add +1/4 to your effective bloodrager class level when determining the strength of your bloodrager bloodline powers.
Cleric Add a +1 bonus on caster level checks made to overcome the spell resistance of dragons.
Druid Add a +1/2 bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks to change a creature’s attitude.
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting an overrun or trip attempt.
Inquisitor Add a +1 bonus on concentration checks when casting inquisitor spells.
Magus Add +1/4 point to your arcane pool.
Oracle Add +1/2 to your effective oracle level for the purpose of determining the effects of your curse ability.
Paladin Add a +1 bonus on concentration checks when casting paladin spells.
Ranger Add +1/4 to a single existing favored enemy bonus (maximum bonus +1 per favored enemy).
Skald Reduce the arcane spell failure chance for casting skald spells when wearing heavy armor by 1%. Once this reduction reaches 10%, you also receives Heavy Armor Proficiency (if you do not already possess it).
Sorcerer Select one bloodline power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. Add +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that bloodline power.
Summoner Add +1 hit point to your eidolon.
Warpriest Add +1/3 to the number of times per day you can use blessings, but these additional uses must be of blessings that affect weapons or armor.
Witch Add +1/4 to the natural armor bonus to AC of your familiar.
Wizard Select one arcane school power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier. Add +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that arcane school power.
